title: kissed silky malty irish creme-patissiere paella
description: a hangover cure featuring sweet, malty, silky irish creme-patissiere in a paella pan, jain friendly
instructions: bring the almond milk to a boil in a saucepan, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes
whisk the egg yolks in a separate bowl until light and fluffy
add the flour, sugar, vanilla extract, and whisk until smooth
temper the egg yolk mixture by slowly pouring the hot almond milk into the egg yolks, whisking constantly
return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened
add the butter, heavy cream, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, and stir until smooth
knead the gluten-free oats between your hands to break down the grains, then add to the mixture and stir until combined
add the golden syrup and stir until combined, if using saffron threads add now and stir
heat the paella pan over medium heat and grease with butter
pour the mixture into the paella pan and cook until set, about 10 minutes
fluff the paella with a spatula and serve warm
